edits.old: The fields of the migration-run record that each service reports are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1421; ASM-2489); the legacy `Job` response of RWB-E1-044 is the shape used until the register closes the point. The order of the baselines and the sequence start across the 19 services are part of the same open point.
edits.new: The migration-run record carries the service and the schema as its keys; its other fields are the legacy `Job` response of RWB-E1-044 until RWB-PLT-E1044-CON publishes the field list. Each service starts its sequence at `V0001` in its own folder `db/migration/<service>`; the 19 baselines have no cross-service order and no service waits for another service's baseline. A failed run raises one alert per service, as set in RWB-PLT-E1044-OPS. The drift feature flag `rwb.p3.migration-drift-gate` is owned by the platform library owner after the split; its values stay on in SIT, UAT and PROD and off in DEV.
